translations.MenuWelcome: 👋 Albums bot Create photo and video albums and invite friends to them with a link. Got an invite code from a friend? Just send it to me.
translations.MediaNotInAlbum: ⚠️ {0} item(s) you sent are not in this album.
translations.ViewGoToPrompt: 🔎 Send the item number to start viewing from, e.g. 42.
translations.ViewGoToInvalid: ⚠️ Please send a single number, e.g. 42.
translations.ViewGoToNearest: ℹ️ #{0} wasn't found – showing the nearest items.
translations.ErrorGeneric: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
translations.ListSharedEmptyHint: Open an invite link to get started.
translations.ErrorAlbumNotOwned: Album not found, or you are not its owner.
translations.AlbumTitleEmpty: The title can't be empty. Try again or send /cancel.
translations.AlbumDeleteConfirm: Delete {0} and all references to its media? This can't be undone.
translations.JoinHint: Send me an invite code, or use the menu.
translations.JoinThrottled: ⏳ Too many wrong codes. Please try again in a few minutes.
translations.JoinWrongCode: ❌ This invite is wrong, expired or used up.
translations.AddOnlyMedia: Only photos and videos can be added. Press Done when you're finished.
translations.AddPrompt: 📥 Adding to {0}. Send or forward as many photos and videos as you like. Nothing is saved until you press Done; duplicates are skipped automatically. If you edit or delete a message before then, the change is taken into account.
translations.AddKeyboardHint: To finish adding, press the Done button below this message or on your keyboard.
translations.AddHintOpenAlbum: To add media, open one of your albums and press ➕ Add media.
translations.RemovePrompt: Type the numbers of the items to delete, e.g. 5, 1 2 3 or 1-3, or send the photos/videos themselves. Numbers are permanent – deleting items never renumbers the others. You'll see a preview first and can cancel before anything is deleted. Don't know the numbers? Open the view with numbers.
translations.RemoveIgnored: ℹ️ {0} number(s) were not found and were ignored.
translations.RemovePreview: 🗑 Preview – {0} Selected {1}, showing {2}–{3}. The numbers under the pictures are listed in picture order. Tap a number to keep that item (↩) or mark it for deletion again (🗑). Type other numbers to replace the selection. Will be deleted: {4} of {1}
translations.RemovePreviewFailed: ⚠️ {0} item(s) could not be shown (they can still be deleted).
translations.RemovePreviewExpired: This preview has expired. Start again from 🗑 Remove media.
translations.ViewNumbersHint: The numbers under the pictures are listed in the same order as the pictures (left to right, top to bottom). Numbers never change.
translations.ViewDeleteHint: 🗑 Type the numbers to delete, e.g. 12, 12 15 18 or 12-15, or send the photos/videos themselves.
translations.ViewNoMatches: ⚠️ No items with those numbers (already deleted or never existed).
translations.StatsNotAllowed: You don't have permission to do that.
translations.AlbumsMenuTitle: 📁 Albums Create a new album, or open one of yours or one shared with you.
translations.AdminAlbumsTitle: 🗑 All albums Choose an album to remove.
translations.ErrorNotAllowed: Album not found, or you don't have permission for that.
translations.TransferPick: 👑 Transfer ownership of {0} Choose the new owner. You will become a manager.
translations.TransferNoMembers: There's nobody to transfer to yet – invite someone first.
translations.MembersTitle: 👥 {0} – people ({1}) Choose a person to manage.
translations.MemberGone: This person is no longer in the album.
translations.MemberKickConfirm: Remove {0} from {1}? They can come back only with a new invitation.
translations.TransferConfirm: Make {0} the owner of {1}? You will become a manager and can't undo this yourself.
translations.TransferDone: Ownership transferred. You are now a manager.
translations.InvitesTitle: 🔗 {0} – invite links Anyone who opens a link becomes a member: they can view the album and leave it.
translations.InviteChooseExpiry: 🔗 New invite link How long should it work?
translations.InviteChooseUses: 🔗 New invite link How many people can join with it?
translations.InviteForwardPrompt: 📨 Forward me any message written by the person you want to invite. They will become a member of {0}. If their privacy settings hide their account in forwards, send them an invite link instead.
translations.InviteForwardHidden: ⚠️ This person's privacy settings hide their account. Send them an invite link instead.
translations.InviteForwardAlready: ℹ️ {0} already has access to this album.
translations.InviteForwardNotNotified: They haven't started the bot yet; once they do, they'll find the album under 📥 Shared with me.
translations.InviteForwardNotForwarded: ⚠️ That's not a message forwarded from a person.
translations.AddedToAlbumNotice: 📥 You were added to the album {0}.
translations.JoinAlready: ℹ️ You already have access to this album.
translations.SongPrompt: 🎵 Send me an audio file (music) to use as the song of {0}. Everyone with access can play it from the album card.
translations.SongPromptReplace: The album already has a song; a new one replaces it.
translations.SongOnlyAudio: ⚠️ Please send an audio file (music), not a document or voice message.
translations.SongCaption: 🎵 {0} Turn it on and enable repeat, then press Done.
translations.SongFailed: ⚠️ The song could not be sent. Ask a manager to set it again.
